rows.grounds: first member of compound describing number of petals
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a pericarp

items.question: What are the defining attributes of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as ṣaṣṭhaṃ cakraṃ.
It is characterized as rājānam, the king.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is the royal cakra distinguished by eight petals and a central pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise sense of rājānam as an epithet in this context is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: But the sixth cakra is the king, having eight petals and a pericarp.
